title: Spanning-Tree Maximization Forces Isoperimetry in the Square Lattice
summary: We determine which connected sets of $N$ vertices in the square lattice support the most spanning trees, using all lattice edges between the chosen vertices. Every maximizer minimizes the number of edges joining the set to the rest of the lattice. Its shape is a rectangle with at most two straight strips of vertices removed at opposite corners. For $N\ge18$, the maximizer is unique up to translation, rotation, and reflection: an explicitly determined rectangle with one possibly empty corner strip removed along its longer side.
